WITH grouped AS (
  SELECT BillingState, COUNT(*) as count 
  FROM Invoice 
  GROUP BY BillingState
),
non_null_groups AS (
  SELECT count 
  FROM grouped 
  WHERE BillingState IS NOT NULL
),
sum_and_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(count) as total_sum,
    AVG(count) as avg_count
  FROM non_null_groups
),
with_metrics AS (
  SELECT 
    nng.count,
    CAST(nng.count AS FLOAT) / sa.total_sum as ratio,
    nng.count - sa.avg_count as diff,
    sa.avg_count
  FROM non_null_groups nng
  CROSS JOIN sum_and_avg sa
),
kept_rows AS (
  SELECT count, ratio, diff
  FROM with_metrics
  WHERE count > avg_count
)
SELECT 
  SUM(count) as total_of_counts,
  AVG(ratio) as avg_of_ratios,
  AVG(diff) as avg_of_diffs
FROM kept_rows
